stemMd: A library predicts that digitizing its rare manuscripts will reduce handling of the originals. Which assumption is most directly relevant?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some researchers who currently handle originals will find digital images adequate for their purposes.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every researcher will stop visiting the library.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The library will acquire no more manuscripts.

explanationMd: The proposed reduction requires substitution: at least some uses of an original must be replaced by uses of an image. If every researcher still needs to handle the original, digitization alone would not reduce handling.

distractorRationale.a: The conclusion concerns handling, not cost.
distractorRationale.d: A reduction does not require universal withdrawal.
distractorRationale.c: Illustrations do not prevent useful digitization.
distractorRationale.e: Acquisitions need not eliminate substitution for existing originals.
